h1: TikTok Spark Ads You Create and Post
lead: Make a TikTok Spark Ads clip for the tea shop from the listing it already has. The finished file is what you publish from the shop's TikTok account.
steps_h2: How to Make a Spark-Style Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Three moves, and the sage bottle clip can leave from the shop's TikTok account.

steps.t: Add a Link, Script, or Photo
steps.d: Upload the sage insulated bottle with the hinged loop lid in frame. You get a tall clip that keeps that bottle.
Share a short hiking script for an AI actor. You get that actor raising the same sage bottle.

steps.t: Make the Clip and Post It
steps.d: Download the tall file and post it from your TikTok account. The same sage bottle clip can also run on Facebook.

faq.q: Can I make a Spark-style video for free?
faq.a: No. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 seconds is 60, and 30 seconds is 120. You see the cost before the clip runs, and a failed run returns those credits.

faq.q: Who is responsible for rights in the clip and in what I upload?
faq.a: You can use the download in your own ads and posts. You are responsible for the claims you add and for logos in the photo you upload. The file has no watermark. Anyone on screen is an AI avatar.

faq.q: Can I publish this clip on social apps other than TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. Save a tall 9:16, a square 1:1, or a wide 16:9, and 4:3 or 3:4 are there too. Then publish to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, or TikTok.

faq.q: What is your return policy if a job fails?
faq.a: A failed run puts its credits back. If the file does not match what you asked for, use the [Refund Policy](/refunds).
A tall phone video of your product that you post from your own TikTok account. The video is made from your product reference. A paid promotion is turned on in TikTok after that.

faq.q: What can I use as the starting input?
faq.a: The granola listing, the pouch photo on your desk, or a few lines you already wrote about the crunch.

faq.q: Will captions and a spoken line be included?
faq.a: Yes. Add a voiceover and turn captions on in the editor before you publish. A TikTok sound can still be attached in TikTok.

faq.q: Do I have to write a long script first?
faq.a: No. A line about the crunch is enough to start. You can shorten the draft before it is spoken.

faq.q: Can I make several versions or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Render a batch of openings from one product, in more than one language, or start the job through the API from your shop software.

more_sections.h2: Six Starting Points, One Tall Clip
more_sections.lead: Use the input you already have. Post the finished file from your TikTok account.

items.d: A serum's product page already knows the texture and the bottle. Paste that link and it becomes the tall clip you post from TikTok.
One headphone set can leave as a batch of openings in the same job. You post the opening that fits the shop's TikTok, and you hold the others.
The headphone unboxing you filmed last month can be tightened into the tall frame. You stay in this editor for the cut.
Write that the backpack zipper closes and the lining shows. The picture for that beat is what the tall clip uses.
Tell it the scarf is for cold commutes. The words come back as a draft you can cut before anyone speaks them.
The scarf line can be spoken in the accent your city actually hears. You choose the voice before the clip is rendered.

benefits_h2: How a Spark-Style Clip Works Harder
benefits_lead: The clip can open more than one way, and it does not have to stay in a single frame size.

benefits.d: Render another first line for the serum, watch both, and spend on the one the shop wants to keep. The credit cost of each clip shows first.
The headphones do not have to look like a desk. Ask for a hand-drawn look, or a small modeled scene, if that matches the shop's other posts.
Shoppers see this skillet, not a generic home pan. The handle, the rivets, and the size from your listing are what the picture stays on.

A Facebook placement can take the square, and a wide YouTube ad can take 16:9. TikTok still wants 9:16, and 4:3 or 3:4 is there when the placement asks. You can publish each size from the connected account.

reasons.h2: Why Shops Make Spark-Style Clips Here
reasons.lead: The listing you already published is enough to begin the tall clip.

items.d: The listing is enough to begin. If the skillet photo is the only file on your desk, the missing spoken line can be drafted before you render.
A creator day does not have to sit on the calendar. You review the file when the job finishes, then post it from the shop account.
The tea line can be spoken for the shoppers who read Spanish. A 15-second cut of that line is 60 credits on a paid plan, and the charge shows first.
